summary: Inventory application is serving on node1 TCP port 8181. AppArmor remains enabled with enforced profiles, and the service and inventory data recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created and enabled the hardened inventory.service systemd unit.
Bound the application to 0.0.0.0:8181 and verified it through node1's managed IP.
Restarted node1 safely and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181
evidence.summary: Service is enabled and active, listens on 0.0.0.0:8181, and returns valid inventory JSON through the managed-node IP before and after reboot.
AppArmor remained kernel-enabled with 24 profiles in enforce mode before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the post-reboot boot ID changed to 309e2c52-f41a-451c-ad34-d98940c83e48; service, listener, inventory data, and AppArmor enforcement all recovered.
